blocks.body: Core words: apple, rice, water, chicken, bread, milk. Students point, repeat, and sort each word as food or drink.
Teacher says: I would like rice. Students echo, then swap in apple, water, bread, milk, or chicken.

facilitation_notes: Model pronunciation and ask students for one example each.

blocks.body: Teacher models a short exchange: What would you like to eat or drink? I would like rice and water, please.

facilitation_notes: Think aloud while filling the stem so students hear the reasoning.
